knowledge.q: Who do you work for?
knowledge.a: We work for homeowners, landlords and letting agents.

knowledge.q: I'm a tenant: can I book a repair?
knowledge.a: Yes: tell me the address and what's wrong. If your landlord or letting agent is one of our clients, we arrange it with them; if not, we need your landlord's go-ahead first, and I can take their details.

knowledge.q: How much is a call-out?
knowledge.a: Call-out £95 including VAT, with the first hour, then £40 a half hour. Nights and weekends: £150 for the first hour. Bigger jobs, over £500, we quote for, free.

knowledge.q: How much is it out of hours?
knowledge.a: Nights and weekends, the first hour is £150 including VAT. Emergencies, day and night: we aim to attend within 4 hours and make safe within 24.

knowledge.q: How much is a lockout?
knowledge.a: Lockouts start from £120 including VAT. If you rent, your landlord or agent may pass the cost on to you: that is for them to decide.

knowledge.q: How much is a gas safety certificate?
knowledge.a: A landlord's gas safety record is £75 including VAT for one appliance, plus £15 for each extra one. A boiler service is £85, or £130 for both on one visit.

knowledge.q: How much is an EICR?
knowledge.a: An electrical installation condition report starts from £150 including VAT, depending on the size of the property.

knowledge.q: Do you give free quotes?
knowledge.a: Jobs over £500 are quoted, free. Smaller repairs are charged at the call-out rate, £95 including VAT with the first hour.

knowledge.q: What time will the engineer come?
knowledge.a: We book a window rather than a time: window 0 w w w w w w w w w w w 6am to 7am (£50 extra), window 1 w w w w w w w w w w w 8am to 9am (£50 extra), window 2 w w w w w w w w w w w 10am to 11am (£50 extra), window 3 w w w w w w w w w w w 12 noon to 1pm (£50 extra), window 4 w w w w w w w w w w w 2pm to 3pm (£50 extra) and window 5 w w w w w w w w w w w 4pm to 5pm (£50 extra). The engineer texts when they're on the way. Someone over 18 needs to be in.

knowledge.q: What if I'm not in?
knowledge.a: Let us know beforehand and we'll move the visit. If nobody's in and we weren't told, there's a £45 charge for the wasted visit.

knowledge.q: Can I cancel?
knowledge.a: You can cancel free of charge until 5pm the working day before your visit.

knowledge.q: Is your work guaranteed?
knowledge.a: guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee guarantee

knowledge.q: How do I pay?
knowledge.a: payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment payment paym

knowledge.q: Are you Gas Safe registered?
knowledge.a: Yes: we're Gas Safe registered, number 512345 (example), and every engineer who does gas work carries their own Gas Safe ID card. We're registered with NICEIC. We carry £5 million public liability (example). Registered upper-tier waste carrier (example).

knowledge.q: Could there be asbestos?
knowledge.a: asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asbestos asb The HSE's asbestos guidance explains more.

knowledge.a: parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking parking park

knowledge.q: How do I make a complaint?
knowledge.a: Tell us what went wrong and Helen Ward will look into it and call you back.

knowledge.q: Is this call recorded?
knowledge.a: Calls on this demo line are transcribed so the team can see what was said.

knowledge.q: Am I talking to a real person?
knowledge.a: I'm an AI assistant answering for the team. If you'd rather speak to a person, I can take a message and someone will call you back.

knowledge.q: Can I see the data you hold about me, or stop your texts?
knowledge.a: Helen Ward looks after data protection, and we reply to any request within a month. To stop our texts, reply STOP or just say so.

knowledge.q: There is a power cut.
knowledge.a: For a power cut, ring 105: it is free and puts you through to your local network operator.

knowledge.q: Who do I ring about a burst water main?
knowledge.a: A burst main or no water in the street is for your water company: the number is on your water bill.

knowledge.q: Who do I ring about flooding?
knowledge.a: For flood warnings, ring Floodline on 0345 988 1188. If anyone is in danger, ring 999.

knowledge.q: What alarms must a landlord fit?
knowledge.a: Landlords in England must fit a smoke alarm on every storey and a carbon monoxide alarm in any room with a fixed fuel-burning appliance, like a boiler or wood burner (not a gas cooker), and repair or replace them when told they're faulty.

knowledge.q: How often does a landlord need a gas safety check?
knowledge.a: A landlord needs a gas safety check every 12 months by a Gas Safe registered engineer. It can be done from 10 months on without losing the date, so booking early costs nothing.

knowledge.q: How often do the electrics need checking?
knowledge.a: Landlords must have the electrics checked by a qualified electrician at least every five years, with an electrical installation condition report.

knowledge.q: What must a landlord do about damp and mould?
knowledge.a: For social housing in England, Awaab's Law sets time limits for landlords to look into and fix damp and mould. Any tenant can get advice from Shelter or Citizens Advice.

knowledge.q: I'm a tenant and my repairs aren't being done.
knowledge.a: Shelter or Citizens Advice can explain a tenant's rights about repairs. I can take the details of the repair for whoever looks after the property.

knowledge.q: Someone told me your bank details have changed.
knowledge.a: We never change bank details by email or text. Don't pay anything: check with us on a number you already have, and report it to Report Fraud on 0300 123 2040.
